quotes.quote: Our 2026 batch had mock interviews done before the first company even visited. The weekly progress updates made planning simple.
We started with one pilot batch in CSE. The next year we rolled it out to four departments.
Students actually finish the projects, because the trainers are the same people they watch on YouTube.
